What is TED?

Telescope Engineering Data (TED) is a system for ingesting, storing, and viewing logs from numerous subsystems and combining them with the telemetry data, all from the Gemini telescope. It provides a web interface based on Grafana software to visualize all data. Grafana is an open-source software that offers to create dashboards with information coming from multiple sources.

In our case, we use 2 sources of data for TED Visualization: - Logs: Logs are loaded from ASCII files and stored in Elasticsearch. - Telemetry: Data is archived by the Archiver Appliance and retrieved using a helper python service

We are committed to enhancing your user experience and providing a valuable tool for your work. Thank you for being part of this journey. If you have any doubts or need further assistance, feel free to contact us in Slack or via email: oscar.fuentes@noirlab.edu
